stem.text: A $0.216\,\text{g}$ sample of an aluminium compound X reacts with an excess of water to produce a single hydrocarbon gas. This gas burns completely in $\text{O}_2$ to form $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ and $\text{CO}_2$ only. The volume of $\text{CO}_2$ at room temperature and pressure is $108\,\text{cm}^{3}$.
What is the formula of X?
